integrity: The proof is a complete symbolic case split on the multiplicative partitions allowed by \(\Omega\le2\). The focal article and its cited problem discussion were inspected directly; targeted database and literature searches found no covering low-multiplicity theorem.
limitations: The theorem treats only pairs for which both consecutive integers have at most two prime factors counted with multiplicity. It does not settle the unrestricted equation \(s(n)=s(n+1)\). The finite verifier is regression evidence, not proof of the unbounded statement.
title: The two-almost-prime barrier for equal consecutive aliquot sums
